sources.researchNote: The full Library of Congress reproduction, also available on Wikimedia Commons, shows the studio mark “L. Gutmann” and the year 1920 on the portrait; these are outside the crop used here. The Library’s Flickr record dates the negative “[between ca. 1920 and ca. 1925]” and identifies Bain News Service as publisher. The inscribed year is not treated as independently confirmed dating of the negative, and the studio mark is not assumed to identify the individual who operated the camera.

media.title: Alfred Piccaver — portrait, Bain News Service
media.altText: Black-and-white portrait photograph of the tenor Alfred Piccaver.
media.publicCaption: Alfred Piccaver, the English-born tenor of the Vienna State Opera, who took the lead in Abenteuer am Lido (1933), the Austrian musical comedy scored by Kaper and Jurmann.
media.publicCreditLine: Portrait marked L. Gutmann, Vienna; Bain News Service, publisher; Library of Congress, George Grantham Bain Collection, ggbain.34250.
media.rightsNote: Public domain in the United States under the PD-US tag on the Wikimedia Commons file. The photograph comes from the Library of Congress George Grantham Bain Collection, for which the Library records no known restrictions on publication. The full reproduction bears an L. Gutmann studio mark and the year 1920; the Library’s record for ggbain.34250 dates the negative approximately between 1920 and 1925.
